Name: Egg Festival Winner Randomized
Author: lemurkat
Description:
Randomly selects a winner between:
[list]
[*]Jas and Vincent
[*]Maru
[*]Sam
[*]Abigail
[*]Leo (if relevant)
[*]Keahi (If RSV installed)
[*]Trinnie (if RSV installed)
[/list]
Changes the final part of the festival event. Not compatible with any other mods that change this - will probably over-ride SVE's if installed with it.

Just a bit of fun for the Easter period.

Downloads.Description:
Updated for 1.6 Y2 posting.
(RSV Characters can only win on odd years.)
